Splitting into 3 separate vaults demands a separate funded juniper account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the haven binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 112 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
